papers.title: Numerical issues in maximum likelihood parameter estimation for Gaussian process interpolation
papers.abstract: This article investigates the origin of numerical issues in maximum likelihood parameter estimation for Gaussian process (GP) interpolation and investigates simple but effective strategies for improving commonly used open-source software implementations. This work targets a basic problem but a host of studies, particularly in the literature of Bayesian optimization, rely on off-the-shelf GP implementations. For the conclusions of these studies to be reliable and reproducible, robust GP implementations are critical.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文关注高斯过程参数估计的数值稳定性，对构建可靠的替代模型有参考价值，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计。
llm.why_not_core: Does not address FEA sampling efficiency, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or biomechanics transferability.

summary_zh.motivation: 高斯过程最大似然估计存在数值问题，影响贝叶斯优化的可靠性。
summary_zh.method: 分析数值问题根源并改进开源GP实现的数值稳定性。
summary_zh.result: 改进策略可提升参数估计的鲁棒性和可重复性。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准测试问题上验证数值稳定性改进效果。

summary_en.motivation: Maximum likelihood estimation for Gaussian processes suffers from numerical instabilities that can compromise the reproducibility of Bayesian optimization studies.
summary_en.method: The paper identifies origins of numerical issues in GP parameter estimation and proposes simple fixes for common open-source implementations.
summary_en.result: The proposed strategies enhance numerical stability and robustness of GP fitting across standard test problems.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks demonstrate improvement in parameter estimation accuracy and reproducibility.

papers.title: Energy Absorption Behaviors of Laser Additive Manufactured Aluminium Alloy Thin-Walled Tube Tailored by Heat Treatment
papers.abstract: Thin-walled metal tubes, because of their low cost, high stiffness and strength combined with a relatively low density, have been extensively applied in transportation vehicle industry as energy absorbers. The traditional methods applied to the metal tube fabrication, however, are time-consuming and materially-inefficient processes. In the present study, taken AlSi10Mg alloy as the model material, the hexagon thin-walled tubes were prepared by Selective laser melting (SLM). The effect of post heat treatment on the energy absorption characteristics of hexagon thin-walled tubes is systematically studied. The results revealed that the subsequent heat treatment significantly improved the energy absorption properties of the hexagonal thin-walled tube, especially the solution heat treatment. Moreover, the energy absorption properties of the AlSi10Mg hexagonal tube obtained in the present work is higher than most of recently reported thin-walled AlSi10Mg tubes fabricated by SLM.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究铝合金薄壁管的能量吸收行为，与生物医学植入物的多孔结构、应力遮挡或骨整合无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on energy absorption of aluminum alloy tubes for automotive applications, with no biomedical context, no porous implant design, no stress shielding analysis, no fatigue testing, and no surface roughness or osseointegration assessment.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究热处理对SLM制备的AlSi10Mg六角薄壁管能量吸收特性的影响。
summary_zh.method: 采用选区激光熔化制备六角薄壁管，并进行不同热处理。
summary_zh.result: 固溶热处理显著提高了管的能量吸收性能，优于文献报道的其他SLM制备的AlSi10Mg管。
summary_zh.validation: 通过准静态压缩实验验证能量吸收性能。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of post heat treatment on the energy absorption behavior of AlSi10Mg hexagonal thin-walled tubes fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Hexagonal thin-walled tubes were fabricated by SLM and subjected to different heat treatments (solution, aging, etc.).
summary_en.result: Solution heat treatment significantly improved the energy absorption properties, outperforming most previously reported SLM-fabricated AlSi10Mg tubes.
summary_en.validation: Quasi-static compression tests were performed to measure energy absorption capacity.

papers.title: 3D Bioprinting of In Vitro Models Using Hydrogel-Based Bioinks.
papers.abstract: Coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19), which has recently emerged as a global pandemic, has caused a serious economic crisis due to the social disconnection and physical distancing in human society. To rapidly respond to the emergence of new diseases, a reliable in vitro model needs to be established expeditiously for the identification of appropriate therapeutic agents. Such models can be of great help in validating the pathological behavior of pathogens and therapeutic agents. Recently, in vitro models representing human organs and tissues and biological functions have been developed based on high-precision 3D bioprinting. In this paper, we delineate an in-depth assessment of the recently developed 3D bioprinting technology and bioinks. In particular, we discuss the latest achievements and future aspects of the use of 3D bioprinting for in vitro modeling.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文综述了3D生物打印在体外模型中的应用，但未涉及人工智能技术。
llm.why_not_core: No AI integration into any bioprinting workflow stage; purely a review of bioprinting and bioinks.

summary_zh.motivation: 快速建立可靠体外模型以应对新疾病
summary_zh.method: 综述3D生物打印技术与水凝胶生物墨水的最新进展
summary_zh.result: 总结了用于体外模型的3D生物打印现状与未来展望

summary_en.motivation: To rapidly establish reliable in vitro models for emerging diseases, this review assesses recent 3D bioprinting technology and hydrogel-based bioinks.
summary_en.method: A comprehensive review of high-precision 3D bioprinting methods and bioink formulations for in vitro modeling.
summary_en.result: The paper summarizes the current achievements and future directions of 3D bioprinting for in vitro models.
summary_en.validation: This is a review without experimental validation.
